round: exact-backbone scaling: window length, anchor density, width
motivation: The structural round on this backbone is closed: decay, position, buyer and combined position+decay all re-express the same representation. Only seed93 decay landed, and its seed-average fails, so it is seed luck rather than a mechanism.
FINDINGS 2.3 states the axes that create real diversity are WINDOW and SEED, not architecture or head. The last four experiments all varied architecture.

The exact backbone hardcodes window=409 and a sparse 14-anchor schedule (186..348 stride 12). The 'two epochs then overfit' rule in FINDINGS 2.6 was measured on that sparse schedule, so anchor density has never been separated from epoch count.

Raw data confirmed to be pre-aggregated user x day over 17 numeric columns. There is no unused richer source (no item_id, category_id or query text), so the remaining gap is modelling capacity on the same channels.
Gap to public top-3 is 0.00095, which equals a signal correlated only r~0.038 with our residual. This is a capacity gap, not a missing-data gap.

phase_B_scale.note: Launched only after phase A completes. Varies anchor density and width at the window chosen by phase A, to test whether the two-epoch overfit rule is an artifact of sparse anchors.

offline_gates.audited_against: the CURRENT admitted pool {w409c, decay_s93}, never against {w409c} alone
offline_gates.rationale: Standing project thresholds, unchanged for this round.

known_limitation_recorded_in_advance: The 96-split audit sits on the January anchor 378, which FINDINGS 2.1 shows mis-ranks models relative to the real gift-peak target, and window length is exactly the axis it got wrong historically. A passing offline gate is therefore necessary but NOT sufficient; any candidate must still clear a public probe against a gate computed with the full admitted pool via --expect-baseline 1.6461788499434364.
submission_policy: No probe is submitted on offline results alone. At most the single best candidate per phase is probed, and only if it clears the offline gate.
